summary: Bug-fix release for LDAP matching, HTTPS reverse-proxy asset pagination, SFTP token exchange, Celery timezone alignment, Compose failure handling, and PostgreSQL upgrade recovery.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fixed LDAP and LDAP HA login failures caused by username case differences during existing-user checks, and aligned user matching and authentication source checks
Fixed asset tree pagination failures caused by inconsistent links behind HTTPS reverse proxies
Fixed connection token exchange errors that prevented SFTP file management from opening
Fixed inconsistent timezone settings between Celery and Core to prevent scheduled task timing discrepancies
Fixed operations continuing after Compose command generation failed, and improved error reporting and failure handling
Fixed Compose configuration path resolution failures and interrupted PostgreSQL upgrade recovery, ensuring the database and Redis are ready before restoring application services

summary: DB2, ClickHouse dual-protocol access, Redis Cluster, OceanBase, SQL Server domain accounts, a local Codex assistant in the client, session lifetime and idle-lock controls, visual approval workflows, and bundled PostgreSQL 18.7 and Redis 8.10.3.

sections.title: New features
items: DB2 database support, with access through the Web Terminal and the native client proxy
Dual-protocol connectivity for ClickHouse, so one asset can accept both HTTP and Native connections
A single-endpoint proxy for Redis Cluster, with node routing and redirection
SQL Server domain account authentication through managed domain accounts using NTLMv2 and Kerberos
Job execution support for Oracle, Dameng, OceanBase, DB2, ClickHouse, and other databases
Account automation support for Dameng, OceanBase MySQL tenants, and ClickHouse
A local Codex assistant in the desktop client
Web session management with configurable login lifetimes, automatic renewal on requests, sign-out after all pages are closed, and automatic idle locking with password-based unlocking

Desktop client session management with configurable maximum login lifetimes that are not extended by activity, reauthentication on expiry, optional reauthentication after fully exiting and reopening the client, and automatic idle locking with password-based unlocking
Tencent Cloud database asset synchronization for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server (Enterprise Edition)

Visual approval workflows with multi-level approvals, conditional branching, all-approver and any-approver modes, approval reassignment, additional approvers, and timeout handling (Enterprise Edition)
Ticket-based approvals for password viewing, account password changes, file uploads and downloads, and recording downloads (Enterprise Edition)
Application credential rotation with alternating primary and standby accounts, account switching across assets, execution history, and client status reporting (Enterprise Edition)
OceanBase support for MySQL-compatible and Oracle-compatible tenants (Enterprise Edition)

sections.title: Security enhancements
items: The workbench adds flexible split views, SSH input broadcasting, and customizable keyboard shortcuts
Scheduled jobs apply the relevant access control policies at execution time
Login lifetime enforcement and reauthentication after exit are improved
Desktop client site security enables HTTPS certificate validation by default, with certificate details, site-specific exceptions, and risk confirmation before HTTP access
Automation execution is hardened with a dedicated SSH Ansible executor, playbook path traversal safeguards, and restrictions on symbolic links, bundled configuration files, and plugins
API parameter validation and organization and role permission checks are strengthened
Sensitive data masking is expanded in database query results and error messages
Database protocol packet validation, command controls, and TLS verification are strengthened
Audit reliability is improved with durable record storage, acknowledgments, retries on failure, and retransmission after restart
Verification code protection prevents codes from appearing in task views or error logs
Existing SSH keys are disabled after a key reset
Scheduled rotation of OpenBao access tokens is supported
FreeRDP is updated to address protocol parsing and memory safety issues
Asset connection ACLs support combinations of request justification, MFA, facial verification, approval, and account operation requirements (Enterprise Edition)

sections.title: Improvements
items: Session recording for the desktop client built-in browser is improved
Recordings support search by window title, with navigation to the corresponding point in the recording
NEC can submit recordings to Video Worker for transcoding
Personal credentials are supported in direct SSH connections
The database workbench is refactored, the Chen backend is migrated to Go, and the SQL editor is upgraded to Monaco
The database workbench improves result editing, paginated exports, execution plans, and relationship diagrams
Database transaction control supports manual commits and rollbacks
Database AI context retrieval supports search by table name, column name, and comment
The audit report center is refactored with configurable sections, report previews, and PDF export
AI conversation audit queries and permission isolation are improved
Asset and account connectivity testing is unified with detailed results and execution history
Task management shows queues, worker processes, and logs, and supports canceling pending tasks and terminating eligible running tasks
Log queries, audit reports, cloud synchronization, and background tasks reduce resource overhead
RDP recording encoding and memory reclamation are optimized
Remote connection settings for printer redirection, security protocols, and Windows key combinations are improved
Asset authorization renewal requests are available from approved authorization tickets, with a new authorization period granted on approval (Enterprise Edition)
Cloud synchronization shows status, progress, changes, and errors, and a pending-review workflow prevents assets from being released when scans are incomplete (Enterprise Edition)

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Database query cancellation, result editing, paginated exports, and connection context
Session invalidation caused by editing personal credential descriptions
Job parameter submission, clearing template variables, and editor state after renaming playbooks
WebSFTP upload chunk ordering and file retention for download auditing
Terminal approval confirmation and cancellation, and Vim rendering
File retention when recording transcoding fails
Username and email conflicts during concurrent user creation, duplicate login logs, and email notifications
Windows asset list loading when the standalone client connects to the Community Edition
Connection compatibility for Oracle SYSDBA, Windows OCI, ClickHouse JDBC/DBeaver, and DBX (Enterprise Edition)
Credential synchronization after account provisioning, and directory service account switching and validation (Enterprise Edition)
Ticket approver previews, approval notifications, and legacy rule migration (Enterprise Edition)

sections.title: Installation and upgrade
items: Bundled PostgreSQL is upgraded to 18.7 and Redis to 8.10.3

Bundled PostgreSQL 10 to 17 is migrated automatically in standard deployments, preserving existing data, backups, and migration progress, with support for resuming interrupted migrations; external databases and customized deployments are excluded
Email addresses must be unique; for existing duplicates, one account keeps the address and the others receive temporary .invalid placeholder addresses, with administrators notified to correct them

Installation and recovery are improved by standardizing component directories, permissions, and key initialization, with better support for legacy Compose versions, executor networking, and service recovery after PostgreSQL upgrades
A routine database backup failure shows a 30-second confirmation prompt, and the upgrade proceeds by default on timeout; backups for PostgreSQL major version migrations remain mandatory
High availability upgrades coordinate PostgreSQL migrations and Redis updates on both nodes through JDMC, and both JDMC instances must support the migration process (Enterprise Edition)
High availability recovery improves primary and standby rejoin, interrupted node decommissioning, and socket conflicts in shared directories (Enterprise Edition)
JDMC updates require matching Core/Xpack support for the new socket discovery mechanism, and environments using the PROXY protocol must configure trusted proxy networks (Enterprise Edition)
Legacy tickets and workflows are migrated automatically, and complex approver rules may be disabled pending review (Enterprise Edition)

summary: High availability hardening for container deployments, stricter Access Token validation, and more reliable Tinker RDP deployment.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Background task records omit the original arguments and keyword arguments at creation, reducing unnecessary parameter persistence
High availability deployments apply stronger persistent write protection for databases and Redis across container restarts, re-creation, and failure recovery
Redeployment completion checks tolerate normal replication lag, and switchover waits and recovery coordination are refined to reduce false failure detection

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Access Token format validation now preserves fallback compatibility with other Bearer Token authentication methods
Tinker applet host deployment checks Group Policy, disables listener NLA before installation, verifies the configuration afterwards, and stops with clear guidance when Group Policy requires NLA
Race conditions involving role callbacks, operation locks, and file synchronization acknowledgements during switchover, automatic rejoin, and startup recovery (Enterprise Edition)
MySQL and MariaDB replication position handling and crash recovery are improved, and a race condition in PostgreSQL replication slot cleanup during standby rebuilds is fixed (Enterprise Edition)
Local administrator credential recovery and health checks during MySQL and MariaDB maintenance no longer use peer credentials or stale application passwords (Enterprise Edition)

summary: A new KoKo TUI, Windows PowerShell over WinRM, Dameng Database support, DBX and Tinker changes, AI-assisted command filters, CIDR zones, persistent tab groups, and many experience improvements.

sections.title: New features
items: KoKo revamps the TUI terminal experience, restoring plain-text connection mode and adding an asset tree, search and filtering, mouse controls, and multi-session management for direct SSH access
Magnus supports connections to Dameng Database (Enterprise Edition)
KoKo supports Windows PowerShell over WinRM and the Dameng Database Web CLI; WinRM provides command auditing, ACL enforcement, session recording, and AI assistance in Luna Web and desktop clients
Tinker is redesigned to provide standalone RDP desktops through the Windows authentication plugin, replacing the previous RemoteApp-based approach
Luna Workspace supports database connections through DBX, and DBX replaces DBeaver as the default remote database application
Command filter rules support AI-assisted drafting and conversational creation through the AI assistant, with an improved configuration experience for command filter rules and command groups

Asset login ACLs support configurable approval exemption periods, so the same user can reconnect to the same asset with the same account without repeated approval during the configured period (Enterprise Edition)
OAuth2 login supports user group synchronization, configurable user group attribute mapping, and certificate verification modes (Enterprise Edition)
SAML2 remote metadata supports configurable certificate verification modes (Enterprise Edition)
Zones support CIDR configuration so assets are assigned automatically based on their addresses
Tabs support persistent grouping that can be restored in future sessions, with drag-and-drop grouping by dropping one tab onto another
Personal credential creation reminders and daily activity summaries, plus recent usage tracking for credentials such as Access Keys, temporary passwords, and connection tokens
Session recordings support batch downloads
Asset authorizations support configurable expiration reminders
Work order auditing supports filtering and exporting by creation time (Enterprise Edition)
JDMC adds primary and standby management, system upgrade management, and patch package management

sections.title: Improvements
items: OpenBao enables HTTPS by default

MFA user settings follow the system configuration by default, authentication methods not enabled at the system level are clearly marked, and MFA is automatically enabled and cannot be disabled when enforced system-wide
SQL execution plan visualization in Chen Web gains a summary view and quick-access toolbar actions
Work order exports convert approval workflows, approvers, approval statuses, and related resources into more readable text (Enterprise Edition)
Lina search lets users edit search condition values
Access control policies support asset-based selection for connection methods (Enterprise Edition)
LDAP supports user group mapping through distinguishedName
Account templates explicitly identify fields that inherit values from the template
In-app notifications support paginated access to all unread messages
The mobile experience has better connection button adaptation and a more compact layout
Keyboard and shortcut controls in the lower-right corner of the interface are improved
Celery logs are consolidated into a single window with separate tabs
The default Ansible WinRM configuration is improved when HTTPS is enabled

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Fix KoKo crashes on certain legacy CPUs
Fix node selections not being saved when creating jobs, and improve permission, command filter rule, and data masking rule checks when selecting assets through nodes
Fix Redis SSL verification settings not taking effect
Fix LDAP connection timeout settings, incorrect LDAP HA user source records, and LDAP user list sorting failures when sort fields are unavailable
Improve Jinja2 content handling and username validation in account automation to keep invalid discovered accounts out of downstream automation
Fix the authorization scope and detail list inconsistency after excluding specific accounts from an asset authorization
Fix anonymous users not being supported correctly for web connections
Fix the scheduled LDAP synchronization toggle not being displayed correctly in the Community Edition
Fix the AI dialog appearing behind the web session interface
Fix the AI panel expanding automatically in the desktop client

summary: The first V5 release: a refreshed native client with a unified connection entry, AI-assisted operations and auditing, and a redesigned KoKo TUI.

sections.title: New features
items: A refreshed native JumpServer Client with a unified entry point for SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, database, and RemoteApp assets, alongside split views, a file workspace, a script library, and SFTP Server connections
AI-assisted command recommendations, real-time operation risk alerts, and automated audit reports
A redesigned KoKo TUI makes it easier to find assets, choose accounts and protocols, and switch between sessions from an SSH terminal
